<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C9H7O4), DBE, aromatic carbons, methyl group, and two carbonyls, the compound is acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin). It can be thought of as the acetyl fragment “CC(=O)O” joined to the salicylic acid fragment “Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O”. These two SMILES strings represent the fragments that can be linked to form the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>['CC(=O)O', 'Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O']</final_answer>
